title: The Unmapped Room

N01.title: The Night Caretaker's First Shift
N01.question: Where do you direct your pry bar and your resolve?

choices.label: Pry open Room 13 immediately
Follow Clara down to the archives

N04.title: Into the Maw
N04.question: How do you strike against the chamber's digestive assault?

choices.label: Charge the center table to free Julian
Shatter the pulsating vanity mirror
Turn back and dive for the closing door

N05.title: The Submerged Ledger
N05.question: How do you respond to Clara's horrific demand?

choices.label: Agree to her terms and follow her to the furnace
Grab the meat cleaver and strike Clara
Kick over the lantern and plunge into the drainage sluice

N08.title: The Drop into the Marrow
N08.question: Where do you navigate through the pitch-black subterranean cavern?

choices.label: Advance toward the pulsing light in the central vault
Scavenge the luggage mounds for supplies
Drag Julian toward the roaring seaward drainage tunnel

N18.title: The Strangled Threshold
N18.question: Do you commit entirely to saving Julian, or try to wedge the shrinking door?

choices.label: Wrestle Julian from the living carpet
Barricade the exit and flee

N19.title: The Shattered Reflection
N19.question: Where do you plunge as the chamber fractures across time?

choices.label: Surrender to the 2 AM temporal reset
Drop through the floorboards into the foundations
Fight your way toward the basement archives

N20.title: The Black Coral Core
N20.question: How do you strike with the emergency fire axe?

choices.label: Bury the axe into the coral heart
Amputate Julian's infected limb
Sever the telegraph cables feeding the heart

N21.title: The Sump of Lost Souls
N21.question: How do you move before the subterranean scavengers overwhelm you?

choices.label: Ignite a flare and charge the coral heart
Retreat through the seaward drainage sluice

N22.title: The Drowned Sluice
N22.question: Which exit do you take before the seawater fills the tunnel to the ceiling?

choices.label: Climb the iron ladder into the boiler room
Follow the submerged pipeline toward the central vault

N23.title: The Blue Phosphorus Furnace
N23.question: What do you do with the ladle and the bucket of blood?

choices.label: Smash the boiler pressure valve
Pour the blood into the furnace
Hurl the blood into Clara's eyes and sabotage the feed line

N24.title: The Archive Siphon
N24.question: Where do you escape before the steam scalds you alive?

choices.label: Breach the boiler room hatchway
Drop into the flooded drainage sluice

logline: A night caretaker at a salt-battered clifftop hotel discovers a phantom room that consumes its occupants, and must choose between sacrificing guests or becoming the hotel's next meal.
